name: Hinged Squares
description: The picture is cut into squares that turn in alternate directions while staying hinged at their corners, so the sheet opens into a checkerboard of diamonds showing the second clip; those diamonds then turn back into place and close the sheet. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: cells
params.description: Number of squares across the height of the frame

params.name: shading
params.description: Strength of the bevel on the turning squares and of the soft shadow they cast into the gaps

params.name: zoom
params.description: How much the view zooms out to keep the opening sheet in frame (0: the sheet grows past the frame edges)
